const base = Sound.state().bgmVol; const ok = Sound.voice('BR_Leona', 'Join', ['Intro']); const t=[]; let min=1, playing=false; for (let i=0;i<40;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const s=Sound.state(); t.push(s.bgmVol); min=Math.min(min, s.bgmVol); playing = playing || s.voicePlaying; } const t2=Date.now(); while (Date.now()-t2 < 20000 && Sound.state().voicePlaying) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const end=Sound.state().bgmVol; const duckDb = (20*Math.log10(min/base)).toFixed(1); return 'DUCK voice=' + ok + ' playing=' + playing + ' base=' + base + ' min=' + min + ' (' + duckDb + 'dB) end=' + end + ' restored=' + (Math.abs(end-base) < 0.02);
